export_evidence: No export (outbound) shipment record found. ImportKey page for this entity is import-only: "Total Shipments 69 Records detected" and every listed row is an inbound consignment into India, e.g. "2026-02-17 | MDNF | JINDAL INFRASTRUCTURES PRIVATE LIMITED | BEARING (FOR SANY SR155) (PARTS OF PILING RIG) | Shanghai, CHINA -> NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | 84828000 | BOL 7585861". The single buyer-side row is also inbound: "JP NELSON EQUIPMENT PTE LTD, 28 BENOI ROAD, SINGAPORE - 629899" listed as supplier to this company. No outbound B/L with Indian-origin goods, destination country and HS code was seen. Source counter: ImportKey reports 69 shipments total; rows actually seen on the free view = 5 dated rows (2026-01-15 to 2026-02-17) plus 5 supplier aggregates and 1 buyer aggregate. Volza, Eximpedia and Trademo free views returned HTTP 403, so no second-source export confirmation was possible.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, and the web_search tool was non-functional during this run (connection refused), so no tender or GST page could be located. Indirect, non-shipment signal only: the import records themselves show operational consumption of piling-rig consumables — "POLYACRYLAMIDE (GRADE - PHPA-MEDIUM) (QTY 10.00 MT) (USED FOR SOIL STABILIZATION DURING PILING JOB BORING WORKS)" (2026-01-23, Qingdao -> Patparganj ICD, HS 39069090) — which implies active piling/boring work in India, but this is a purchase, not evidence of a domestic supply contract. Domestic supply therefore recorded as unknown, not confirmed.
note: Role: this entity is an importer/buyer of piling-rig spares and drilling consumables (bearings, roller bits, teeth holders, alloy holders, polyacrylamide) from Chinese suppliers (MDNF, Cangzhou Great Drill Bits, SMSCC Tianjin, Zibo Ruijie, Beijing Yuxiangyihao, Xiamen Globe Truth, Hebei Runhong) — i.e. it behaves as a piling/construction contractor or equipment operator, not as an exporter. Declared HS 843041 (machinery for boring/sinking wells) does not match any observed record: the actual codes seen on its customs rows are 84828000, 82071900, 84311090, 39069090 — all on the import side. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual activity (imports of 8431/8207/8482 spares and 3906 polymer), verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected. Per rule 5: no traces of export shipments found; domestic supply traces not found either — status recorded as unknown rather than 'conditionally accepted'. Revenue and export volume: null (not public, not invented). CIN/PAN: null — registry pages were blocked (HTTP 403), so no identifier is asserted.
